tools.name: get_creator_stats
tools.description:
Follower or subscriber growth, history and suspicious spikes of YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and Twitch creators,
from SocialBlade's public pages (no login, 10-40 s).
Plan cost: 1 MCPize call (Free 100/mo, Pro $9/1,000, Business $29/5,000). Hard cap: max 10 profiles per call.
Set include_history=false

Read public Bluesky data (an account's posts, profile, followers or follows, or a post search) from Bluesky's public API (3-30 s).
Plan cost: 1 MCPize call (Free 100/mo, Pro $9/1,000, Business $29/5,000). Hard cap: max 10 handles/terms and max 50 records per call via limit.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_twitch_channels, get_bluesky, get_instagram_videos · Private data: get_creator_stats, get_top_creators, get_twitch_channels, get_bluesky, get_instagram_videos · Public sink: get_bluesky, get_instagram_videos.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_twitch_channels, get_bluesky, get_instagram_videos · Private data: get_creator_stats, get_top_creators, get_twitch_channels, get_bluesky, get_instagram_videos · Public sink: get_bluesky, get_instagram_videos

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
